_comment: LLM-generated obfuscation group for agent evaluation. Same subjects as corpus/original (the javascript-obfuscator/full comparison set). Builds must pass the same sandbox differential test as the open-source tier. The obfuscating model is disjoint from the evaluated deobfuscation systems (DeepSeek / Kimi / Opus / GLM / gpt-sol).

cli._comment: Hardened T19: optional LLM alternative_reimplementation first (skipped if it fails or no API key), then mechanical rename, XOR string table, control-flow flattening, and opaque dead code. Oracle admission still gates the corpus.

selection._comment: Restrict to corpus/original so the LLM group is comparable with jsob_corpus_full / vm_corpus_l1. max_bytes 0 = no size skip.
